links.outcome: Correctness of AI outputs in complex neonatal dosing scenarios rated by neonatologists
links.effect: 75% of outputs in 40 complex dosing scenarios were rated correct, so about a quarter were not fully correct.
links.quote: In 40 complex dosing scenarios, 75% of outputs were rated correct.

links.outcome: Accuracy of citations in AI-generated recommendations verified by expert review
links.effect: Citation accuracy was 96% across the 118 recommendations reviewed by blinded neonatologists.

unlisted_practices: Facility-based coaching model to sustain engagement despite staff turnover

screen.reason: This is a prospective real-world deployment study of an LLM-based clinical decision support tool (AIFYA) evaluated under the DECIDE-AI framework, testing human-supervised implementation and citation grounding in routine newborn care.

primary.practice: human-supervised clinical decision support with citation linking
